# Oclean

> Oclean is the official Spanish store for intelligent sonic electric toothbrushes and oral care devices featuring advanced technologies like Maglev motors, AI-powered tracking, and smart displays.

Oclean specializes in premium and budget-friendly electric toothbrush solutions for families, with models ranging from professional AI-guided options to kids' toothbrushes. The site offers comprehensive product comparisons and detailed specifications for informed purchasing decisions.

## Key Topics

- Sonic electric toothbrush
- Maglev motor technology
- AI-powered brushing
- Smart display
- IPX7 water resistance
- Battery life
- Oclean X Pro 20
- Oclean X Ultra 20
- DuPont bristles
- Type-C charging
- Smart tracking
- Oral hygiene
- FlexFit Tech
- Waterproof design
- Family oral care
